Settings.ThemeHint: Dark is the base. Light changes the substrate under the same palette; the window frame stays dark in both, because the frame is the application and not the sheet.
Settings.DiceSoNiceHint: Shows themed Hope, Fear, advantage, and disadvantage dice when Dice So Nice is installed.
Settings.ChangeLogHint: Records one entry in the GM's activity log when a character's Hit Points, Stress, Armor Slots, Hope, counters or loadout settle. Coalesced, so applying damage is one entry rather than four, and a change taken straight back is not recorded at all. Nothing is posted to chat, and players see none of it. Rests and character creation post their own card and are left alone.
Settings.TokenChipHint: Draws each creature's Hit Points, Stress, Armor Slots and Hope on its own token, as arcs around it. Replaces Foundry's bars, which cannot say whether the next hit costs one box or four.
Settings.TokenChipScaleHint: How far the resource rings sit from a creature. A dynamic token ring and a scaled token texture are already answered automatically; this is the correction for anything they miss. 1 is normal.
Settings.RangeRuler: Range rings on the selected token
Settings.RangeRulerHint: Draws Melee, Very Close, Close and Far as rings around whichever token you have selected, measured from its edge and in the scene's own units. Yours only — a selection exists on one screen.
Settings.AdversaryChip: What players see on adversary tokens
Settings.AdversaryChipHint: A GM always sees everything. This is what everybody else sees on an adversary: nothing, the tracks without the numbers behind them, or the same chip the GM has. Vulnerable is shown either way — a creature that is easier to hit is a fact the table has already earned.
Settings.MassiveDamageHint: Damage at or above twice your Severe threshold marks 4 Hit Points rather than 3. The SRD prints this as optional; this system has always applied it, so it is on by default — turning it off changes what a hit costs at your table.
Settings.DefinedRangesHint: Measures the range rings in the squares the SRD prints for grid play — Melee 1, Very Close 3, Close 6, Far 12 — rather than converting the book’s approximate distances. It moves one band: Very Close goes from 2 squares to 3.

AdversaryChip.Marks: The tracks, but not the Difficulty

Chat.Reroll: Roll this die again. The face it showed stays on the card, struck through.

Warning.LoadoutFull: Your loadout already holds {max} cards. Send one to the vault first.
Warning.SecondaryBlocked: Your primary weapon is Two-Handed — there is no free hand for a secondary.
Warning.NotYours: That is not your character to spend for.
Warning.GMOnly: Only a GM can change the Fear pool.
Warning.CannotPay: That resource cannot be marked or spent.
Warning.AlreadyClaimed: That has already been taken from this roll.
Warning.RollSettled: Something on this roll has already been claimed, so its dice are settled.
Warning.NoWeapon: The weapon this attack was made with is no longer on the sheet.
Warning.NotEnoughHope: An Experience costs a Hope, and you are short {need}.
Warning.NoClass: No class on this character yet — drag one in from the compendium.
Warning.NoUnmarkedTraits: This advancement raises two unmarked traits, and {left} is left unmarked. Marks clear on entering the next tier.
Warning.NotEnoughExperiences: This advancement raises two Experiences, and there are fewer than two to raise. Add them on the adjust tab.
Warning.NoCardsLeft: No domain card left to take — your domains hold nothing at level {level} or lower that you do not already have.
Warning.NoSelection: Select the token or tokens this lands on first.
Warning.NoCharacter: No character is assigned to you — select a token you own, or ask your GM to assign one.
Warning.NoFeatureCost: {name} costs {cost}, and you cannot pay it.
Warning.OtherSubclass: Still holding {names}. That card was not added by character creation, so it has been left alone — remove it by hand if you meant to change subclass.
Warning.OneTransformation: {name} is already {held}, and a character can have only one transformation. Remove that card first if you meant to change it.
Warning.NoTokenStudio: Phil's Token Studio is not installed or is switched off in this world.
Warning.TokenStudioFailed: Phil's Token Studio could not be opened — see the console for what it said.
Warning.TokenStudioNotYours: That is not your actor to edit.

Advance.TraitsHint: Choose two unmarked traits. Each gains +1 and is marked until the next tier.
Advance.ExperiencesHint: Choose two Experiences. Each gains a permanent +1.
Advance.GainedExperience: Tier {tier}: gained an Experience at +2 — name it on the adjust tab.
Advance.CardHint: One card from your domains, at level {level} or lower. It goes into your loadout if there is room, and the vault if there is not.
Advance.LevelCardsHint: Every level gives you a domain card at your level or lower — the printed level-up's step 4, and not the advancement option beside it. A level that has not spent its card says so here.

Damage.Title: {name} takes damage
Damage.Rule: One Armor Slot lowers the damage by one threshold.
Damage.BeyondRule: Past one Armor Slot — a card is paying for this.

Resource.Refreshed: {n} refreshed at the end of the {scope}.

Rest.Title: {kind}
Rest.Hint: {n} downtime moves. Each applies the moment you take it.

Delete.Title: Delete item
Delete.Body: Delete {name} from this character? This cannot be undone.

Create.Title: Make a character
Create.ChangeClassHint: Becoming a {name} takes these with it. Anything you dragged in yourself is left alone.

Activity.Title: Activity
Activity.ClearBody: Everything recorded so far goes, for every GM at the table. Nothing on anybody's sheet changes.
Activity.Off: Not watching. Nothing that happens to a character is being recorded while this is off.
Activity.EmptyNote: Changes to a character's tracks, counters and loadout land here as they settle.
Activity.GMOnly: The activity log is the GM's record of the table.
Activity.Failed: The activity log could not be opened — see the console.

Condition.Title: Name a condition
Condition.Hint: Daggerheart names sixteen conditions. This is for the ones it does not: what you tell the table is happening to this creature.

Migration.Done: Daggerheart: brought {n} document(s) up to date with SRD 2.0.
Migration.Skipped: Daggerheart: left {n} edited document(s) alone. See the console for which.
Migration.Failed: Daggerheart: {n} migration step(s) failed. Nothing was marked as migrated — see the console, and report this before playing.

Variant.EverydayHeroHint: A full alternate tier-1 equipment table for characters with no access to standard weapons and armor — cleavers, pitchforks, enchanted broomsticks. Adds 36 documents and offers them at character creation.
Variant.FeastsHint: Harvest ingredients from defeated creatures and the landscape, then cook them during downtime. Adds the six flavors, the ingredient and meal tables, and the harvesting rules.
Variant.GrimdarkHint: A corrupting Shadow and the Sacred Bonfires that hold it off. Adds the Shadow-Touched adversary feature and the frame’s rules.
Variant.TechHint: Technology in place of magic. Adds Iconic Weapons and their upgrades, the scrap and parts tables, and credits in place of gold.
Variant.WesternHint: Adds the frame’s equipment, the Roped condition and its duel rules.
Variant.ColossalHint: Creatures fought a limb at a time. Adds the Broken and Destroyed states and the rules for building one.
Variant.MagicSchoolHint: Flight as a trait-driven skill. Adds the frame’s rules and its trait table.
Variant.FairyTaleHint: Adds the Cursed condition and the frame’s bargain and boon rules.
Variant.MonsterHuntingHint: Adds the hunter’s equipment table, its warded armor, and the rules for tracking and taking a contract.
Variant.HexCrawlHint: Adds the Blighted adversary feature, the Frostbitten and Nauseated conditions, and the habitat, terrain and encounter tables.

Focus.Rule: Clear your Focus, roll a d6 per point of Instinct, and gain Focus equal to the highest result.
Focus.NoDice: Refocus rolls a d6 per point of Instinct — at {mod} there is nothing to roll, so the pool is left where it is.
